/bin/bash -lc 'verify_tmp=$(find "$TMPDIR" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'iiti-verify.*' | sort | tail -1)
for spec in \\
  \"academic_program|https://academic.iiti.ac.in/academic_program.php\" \\
  \"phd_admission_info|https://www.iiti.ac.in/admissions/phd_info/engineering/important_dates\" \\
  \"phd_info|https://www.iiti.ac.in/admissions/phd_info\" \\
  \"departments|https://www.iiti.ac.in/administration/office_of_dept_schools\"; do
  name="'${spec%%|*}; url=${spec#*|}
  curl --insecure -L --fail --silent --show-error "$url" -o "$verify_tmp/$name.html"
  printf '"'%s ' \""'$name"; wc -c < "$verify_tmp/$name.html"
done
python3 - "$verify_tmp/academic_program.html" "$verify_tmp/phd_admission_info.html" "$verify_tmp/phd_info.html" "$verify_tmp/departments.html" <<'"'PY'
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import sys,re
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
 print('\\n===',path,'===')
 soup=BeautifulSoup(open(path,encoding='utf-8'),'html.parser')
 print('title:', soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else '')
 txt=' '.join(soup.stripped_strings)
 for p in ['B.Tech','B.Des','B.S.','M.Tech','M.Sc','MS','M.A.','PhD','Ph.D','Doctor','program','programme','Duration','Eligibility','Department','School']:
  hits=[m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(p),txt,re.I)]
  if hits: print(p,len(hits),[txt[max(0,i-100):i+180] for i in hits[:8]])
 print('h1', [x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in soup.find_all(['h1','h2','h3'])][:80])
PY"
